entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi, Sarah. I... I need to make a return. I ordered this jersey a while back and I'm just so disappointed.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into this for you. Just to be clear, what specifically is the issue with the jersey?

It's the wrong size. I mean, it's the size I always order, but this one is just far too tight. I can barely get it on. I was hoping to exchange it, but it's been a while and I... I've just had some unexpected bills. I really needed this money back.
I understand completely. Let's see what we can do. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's... VF-8675309. I've been a loyal customer for years, I really hope you can help me.
Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order. It looks like the Aero Pro jersey was delivered 84 days ago.
Oh... is that too long? I was so busy, I just didn't get around to it. I was really counting on this.
Not at all. You're still well within our 90-day return window for standard items. Since you're unhappy with the fit, I can absolutely process a full refund for you.
Really? Oh, thank you! That's such a relief. I was so worried. Thank you so much, Sarah.

You're very welcome. I'm happy I could resolve this for you. I've just initiated the return in our system and sent a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on file. Just pack the jersey back up, attach the label, and drop it at any post office. Your refund will be processed once we receive it.
That's perfect. I'll get that sent out today. You've been a huge help.
Glad to hear it. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again.
You're welcome. Have a great day, and thank you for calling VeloFit.
